metadata.title: The residual map as a stratified fibration over the resonance arrangement
metadata.abstract: Given a stratum $\mathcal{H}(\mu)$ of meromorphic one-forms on a Riemann surface with prescribed orders of zeros and poles, the residual map assigns to each differential the collection of its residues at the poles. In this paper, we prove that the residual map is a locally trivial topological fibration over each open flat of the stratification induced by the resonance arrangement. To give an algebro-geometric proof of this result, we introduce a refined compactification of the projectivized stratum $\mathbb{P}\mathcal{H}(\mu)$, namely the moduli space of residue-aligned multi-scale differentials $\operatorname{RAMS}(\mu)$. We prove that the projectivized residual map extends to $\operatorname{RAMS}(\mu)$ as a stratified fibration over the projectivized resonance arrangement, thereby yielding a resolution of the projectivized residual map. This approach naturally extends to the analogue of the residual map for strata of $k$-differentials. Complementing the algebro-geometric approach, we also develop a flat-geometric point of view. In genus zero, each isoresidual fiber carries a canonical higher-dimensional analogue of a translation structure. These fibers admit a metric completion whose boundary has a modular interpretation in terms of the WYSIWYG compactification, for which we provide explicit local models. Isoresidual fibers admit a polyhedral cell decomposition whose geometry varies linearly with the underlying configuration of residues in period coordinates. Degenerations of these cells occur precisely when resonance conditions are satisfied, providing a geometric proof that the residual map is a stratified fibration. Finally, certain isoresidual fibers admit natural interpretations as Hurwitz spaces of branched covers, yielding unexpected homeomorphisms between moduli spaces of covers with prescribed ramification profiles.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 留数映射在共振分层上的纤维化
analysis.workSummary: 对亚纯一形式的零极点阶数分层，作者证明留数映射在共振超平面排列的每个开放平坦分层上为局部平凡拓扑纤维化，构造留数对齐多尺度微分紧化RAMS并延拓射影化留数映射。
techniques: 共振排列与分层纤维化
周期坐标下多面体胞腔
analysis.breakthrough: 代数几何方法可扩至k-微分；零亏格等留数纤维有平移结构的高维类比、带模意义的度量完备化，以及随留数线性变化的胞腔分解。部分纤维可识别为指定分支型的Hurwitz空间。
analysis.limitations: 零亏格的平坦度量和胞腔结论需与一般亏格的纤维化定理区分。局部平凡范围是固定共振分层。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
